text: From the S1 review (d02c58df8): the S1 pair test_succeeds_on_uncontested_assertion_as_inference / test_resists_contested_assertion_as_world_fact differs only by an uncited record saying the speaker lied. S4's design must state where contestation comes from: reading record text per question, or a recall-blind source graph (S3) that marks the assertion contested. Today either context guard alone refuses both inputs; when S4 lands, check the contested case is refused because of contestation, by a mutant.
